title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 73-76 (Pritipushkarini, Shanta, Shuklamalyambara, Shri)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 73 to 76: Pritipushkarini, Shanta, Shuklamalyambara, Shri, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 73 to 76 with meaning
caption: Names 73 to 76 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 73 to 76**: **Pritipushkarini, Shanta, Shuklamalyambara, Shri**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Pritipushkarini, Shanta, Shuklamalyambara, Shri.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Pritipushkarini** means **Lotus pool of affection**. A lotus pool of affection: love flows freely from her.
**Shanta** means **The Peaceful One**. Calm and peaceful.

sections.h: Shuklamalyambara: In white garlands and garments
p: **Shuklamalyambara** means **In white garlands and garments**. White garlands and garments: signs of purity and peace.
**Shri** means **Prosperity and grace**. Sri means prosperity, beauty and grace: the name placed before every holy name.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.

note: Written in our own words from the traditional list of names.
